name: Strength Pro Plus Vanilla Delight Flavour
ingredients_raw: MALTODEXTRIN, MILK SOLIDS (SODIUM CASEINATE (11.3%), WHEY PROTEIN CONCENTRATE (5.5%)), SUCROSE, EDIBLE VEGETABLE OILS (HIGH OLEIC SUNFLOWER OIL, SOY OIL, COCONUT OIL), SOY PROTEIN ISOLATE (5.3%), FRUCTO-OLIGOSACCHARIDE (FOS) (4.2%), MINERALS, CALCIUM B-HYDROXY-B-METHYLBUTYRATE MONOHYDRATE (CaHMB), FLAVOURS (NATURAL, NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES), CHOLINE CHLORIDE, VITAMINS, ANTIOXIDANTS (MIXED TOCOPHEROLS), BETA CAROTENE. CONTAINS MILK AND SOY.
